steps.text: 分析 积分区域是圆形域，采用极坐标. 关键是要将被积函数用 $\frac{\partial^2 f}{\partial x^2} + \frac{\partial^2 f}{\partial y^2}$ 来表示，为此可在半径为 $\rho (0 \leqslant \rho \leqslant 1)$ 的圆周 $L_{\rho}$ 上运用格林公式；另外的方法是利用二重积分的分部积分公式.

方法1 采用极坐标 $x = \rho \cos \varphi, y = \rho \sin \varphi$ ，则左边积分

$$
I = \int_ {0} ^ {1} \rho d \rho \int_ {0} ^ {2 \pi} \left(\rho \cos \varphi \cdot \frac {\partial f}{\partial x} + \rho \sin \varphi \cdot \frac {\partial f}{\partial y}\right) d \varphi = \int_ {0} ^ {1} \rho d \rho \int_ {x ^ {2} + y ^ {2} = \rho^ {2}} \left(\frac {\partial f}{\partial x} d y - \frac {\partial f}{\partial y} d x\right).
$$

记 $L_{\rho}: x = \rho \cos \varphi, y = \rho \sin \varphi$ （逆时针方向）是半径为 $\rho (0 \leqslant \rho \leqslant 1)$ 的圆，则

$$
\rho \cos \varphi d \varphi = d y, \quad \rho \sin \varphi d \varphi = - d x,

I = \int_ {0} ^ {1} \rho d \rho \int_ {L \rho} \left(\frac {\partial f}{\partial x} d y - \frac {\partial f}{\partial y} d x\right).
$$

对曲线积分利用格林公式，有

$$
\begin{array}{l} \int_ {L \rho} \left(\frac {\partial f}{\partial x} d y - \frac {\partial f}{\partial y} d x\right) = \iint_ {x ^ {2} + y ^ {2} \leqslant \rho^ {2}} \left(\frac {\partial^ {2} f}{\partial x ^ {2}} + \frac {\partial^ {2} f}{\partial y ^ {2}}\right) d x d y \\ = \iint_ {x ^ {2} + y ^ {2} \leqslant \rho^ {2}} e ^ {- (x ^ {2} + y ^ {2})} d x d y = \int_ {0} ^ {2 \pi} d \theta \int_ {0} ^ {\rho} e ^ {- r ^ {2}} r d r = \pi (1 - e ^ {- \rho^ {2}}). \end{array}
$$

所以

$$
I = \int_ {0} ^ {1} \pi \rho (1 - e ^ {- \rho^ {2}}) d \rho = \frac {\pi}{2 e}.
$$

方法 2 由格林公式，可导出二重积分的分部积分公式：

$$
\iint_ {D} u \frac {\partial v}{\partial x} \mathrm{d} x \mathrm{d} y = \oint_ {\partial D} u v \mathrm{d} y - \iint_ {D} v \frac {\partial u}{\partial x} \mathrm{d} x \mathrm{d} y \text {及} \iint_ {D} u \frac {\partial v}{\partial y} \mathrm{d} x \mathrm{d} y = - \oint_ {\partial D} u v \mathrm{d} x - \iint_ {D} v \frac {\partial u}{\partial y} \mathrm{d} x \mathrm{d} y.
$$

其中 $\partial D$ 为闭区域 $D$ 的正向边界，它是一条分段光滑闭曲线，函数 $u(x,y)$ 和 $v(x,y)$ 在闭区域 $D$ 上有一阶连续偏导数，因为

$$
I = \iint_ {D} \left(x \frac {\partial f}{\partial x} + y \frac {\partial f}{\partial y}\right) d x d y = \frac {1}{2} \iint_ {D} \left(f _ {x} \frac {\partial \left(x ^ {2} + y ^ {2}\right)}{\partial x} + f _ {y} \frac {\partial \left(x ^ {2} + y ^ {2}\right)}{\partial y}\right) d x d y,
$$

依据这两个二重积分的分部积分公式，得

$$
I = \frac {1}{2} \oint_ {\partial D} (x ^ {2} + y ^ {2}) f _ {x} d y - (x ^ {2} + y ^ {2}) f _ {y} d x - \frac {1}{2} \iint_ {D} (x ^ {2} + y ^ {2}) (f _ {x x} + f _ {y y}) d x d y.
$$

本题中 $D: x^{2} + y^{2} \leqslant 1$ 的边界为 $\partial D: x^{2} + y^{2} = 1$ ，所以

$$
\begin{array}{r l} & {I = \frac {1}{2} \oint_ {\partial D} f _ {x}   \mathrm{d} y - f _ {y}   \mathrm{d} x - \frac {1}{2}  \iint_ {D} (x ^ {2} + y ^ {2}) (f _ {x x} + f _ {y y})   \mathrm{d} x   \mathrm{d} y} \\ & {\quad \stackrel {\text {格林公式}} {=} \frac {1}{2}  \iint_ {D} (f _ {x x} + f _ {y y})   \mathrm{d} x   \mathrm{d} y - \frac {1}{2}  \iint_ {D} (x ^ {2} + y ^ {2}) (f _ {x x} + f _ {y y})   \mathrm{d} x   \mathrm{d} y} \\ & {\quad = \frac {1}{2}  \iint_ {D} (1 - x ^ {2} - y ^ {2}) e ^ {- (x ^ {2} + y ^ {2})}   \mathrm{d} x   \mathrm{d} y = \frac {1}{2}  \int_ {0} ^ {2 \pi} \mathrm{d} \varphi  \int_ {0} ^ {1} (1 - \rho^ {2}) e ^ {- \rho^ {2}} \rho   \mathrm{d} \rho = \frac {\pi}{2 e}.} \end{array}
$$
